finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

The bundler renamed `retries` to `retryCount`, which threw a `TypeError` in [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6). The new config loader returns `undefined` for unset flags where the old one returned `false`, which threw in [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7). Both now accept either shape.

The 8 remaining warnings are real deprecations. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is the one worth fixing next.
